bio.text: Jenny Willford, a Democrat, has represented District 34 in the Colorado House of Representatives since January 2023.
According to Ballotpedia, she advanced from the June 30, 2026 Democratic primary and is on the November 3, 2026 ballot for re-election.
Willford earned a B.A. from the University of Wyoming in 2009 and an M.A. in human rights and political science from the University of Manchester in 2010.

Her career experience includes founding Willford Strategies, working as a decarbonization program manager with the Colorado Sierra Club, and serving as executive director of Emerge Colorado; she also served as mayor pro tem and a city council member of Northglenn.
